kindex.lead: Normally above 2. Under 1, the crowd is puking and vol is spiking at the same time — capitulation. It describes the water level; it is not an instruction.
kindex.l2: 🟡 1.5 – 2 — Watch. Fear is starting to stack.
kindex.l3: 🟠 1 – 1.5 — Fear. Most pullbacks historically stopped here.
kindex.l4: 🔴 K < 1 — Capitulation. This is the print the receipt above is built on.

ex.k_how: K = CNN Fear & Greed ÷ VIX. Normally >2; lower = more panic. Four bands, pushed only on a band change
ex.k_l4: Bands: K<2 watch · K<1.5 deploy 1–2 · K<1 capitulation
ex.k_after: How it works (briefly): two public gauges divided into one “water level”; a push only when a band is crossed. K<1 is the strongest band — SMH averaged +49% over the next 60 days after each print in the last 5 years (backtest, N in the ledger).
ex.k_more: The K-index is not a buy/sell instruction; it is a water-level gauge for staged DCA.

refuse.lead: Trust is built on restraint. Here is what we deliberately choose NOT to do — and it is exactly why we can be honest with you.
refuse.r1: Don't connect to your brokerage · can't touch your account · never place a trade
refuse.r1_why: Your money never passes through us — nothing to hack, nothing to front-run.
refuse.r2: Don't do your taxes · don't do personalized financial planning
refuse.r2_why: We're not a licensed advisor, and we won't pretend to know your whole financial life.
refuse.r3: Don't sell your data · don't take payment-for-order-flow kickbacks
refuse.r3_why: You pay us, so you're the customer — never the product being resold.
refuse.r4: Don't hide losers — every signal, win OR loss, is on the public ledger
refuse.r4_why: Red ink stays on the record, so you can check us yourself.
refuse.payoff: Because we're not trying to be your broker or your advisor, we can just be honest —
refuse.payoff_em: an investment companion whose only job is to be honest with you.
